item.title: SECURITY: ⚠️ AI just caught a bug in Bitcoin Core that could have frozen Bitcoin…
item.description: SECURITY: ⚠️ AI just caught a bug in Bitcoin Core that could have frozen Bitcoin nodes, and it's already fixed. An attacker could have stalled nodes by repeating one transaction ID 50,000 times, delaying blocks and deposits. Jack Dorsey's Block found it with an AI scanner, and Bitcoin Core developers patched it before anyone could exploit it. Source: https://x.com/CryptosR_Us/status/2124461657313153323
